scope: User-selected daily and intraday research focused on pre-positioning or early entry in potential large movers. Incentive-driven is provisionally interpreted as catalyst/event-driven; detailed hypotheses remain proposals.
objective: Test whether time-known catalysts and early observable price/liquidity signals improve predeclared outcomes after realistic costs, without selecting eventual winners retrospectively.

hypotheses.description: Deterministic fixed schedule to verify accounting and timing, without alpha inference.
A catalyst schedule known before the decision plus predeclared incentive/fundamental/liquidity features predicts a predeclared outcome relative to controls.
hypotheses.boundary: Future event content, surprise, later schedule revisions and eventual mover ranking cannot be features. No pre-positioning on an unscheduled release learned afterward.

hypotheses.description: An actually received catalyst with trailing relative volume, price movement and liquidity features identifies candidates early enough to retain value after costs.
hypotheses.boundary: Freeze reaction window, event-to-receipt delay, feature window, eligible quote/fill rules, exit and nonfill treatment before scoring.

hypotheses.description: Compare event-only, price/volume-only, combined and no-signal controls using the same eligible universe, information cutoff and execution assumptions.
hypotheses.boundary: Track every attempted feature/model/parameter family in the trial ledger, including unsuccessful variants.

data_requirements: Entitled immutable raw snapshot and hashes; source, feed, adjustment policy and pagination completeness.
Availability evidence separate from event time and local ingestion time; revisions selected only when known by the decision cutoff.
Corporate actions, cash dividends, splits, delistings and any universe membership changes must have explicit treatment.
An actual accepted dataset is required before market-performance claims. Synthetic temporal fixtures and bundled LEAN data only establish scoped mechanics.
Catalyst source ID, initial publication, revision/updated time, local received time, snapshot identity and original text hash; event schedules require as-known revision history.
Versioned complete eligible candidate universe at each cutoff, including nonmovers, delistings, halted and rejected names; price, volume, float/liquidity and session filters must be known then.

Feed, session, late/corrected bars, quote timestamp/spread, halt/resumption, corporate-action and news duplication semantics are explicit. Historical news timestamps alone do not reconstruct historical ingestion latency.

Historical +200% event extraction must preserve price anchor/horizon, first crossing, raw/adjusted values, source/feed, IPO/mapping/corporate actions, halt/session/liquidity and bad-tick checks. No case census was acquired in this wave.
Current microsecond PIT fixture rejects native nanosecond ticks; preserve original timestamp/sequence and require exact finer precision or an independently validated conservative policy.

evaluation.split_policy: Chronological train/validation/frozen-holdout intervals chosen and recorded before scoring; no shuffled cross-validation.
evaluation.embargo_and_purge: Derive from target/holding overlap and information timing; a fixed arbitrary gap is not a guarantee of no leakage.
evaluation.trial_ledger: Record every attempted rule/parameter/version, including rejected variants and failures. A pre-existing historical interval is not automatically an unseen holdout.
metrics: Fill quantity, latency and capacity assumptions
Dependence-aware uncertainty where sample size supports it
Benchmark-relative outcomes under identical information/cost assumptions
Candidate precision/recall at the frozen forward-move target; lead time and alert count
Net outcomes including all signals, nonfills, false positives, halted names and missed moves
Performance by daily/intraday, catalyst type, session, liquidity and regime with minimum-sample rules declared before evaluation
mechanical_acceptance: No post-cutoff observations or revisions selected
Exact cash, position and fee reconciliation
Adverse costs worsen a fixed schedule as expected
Explicit failures for unsupported/unknown order fields
Repeatable results tied to code/data/config hashes

target_definition.mover_label: Predeclare forward horizon, return/volatility definition and positive/negative direction. Future mover labels are outcomes only.
target_definition.candidate_selection: Score every eligible candidate at each cutoff. Never construct the universe from the eventual top gainers or surviving winners.
target_definition.preposition_and_entry: Evaluate scheduled pre-event and post-signal entry as separate cohorts; report latency, false positives and missed moves.

evaluation.event_grouping: Keep related issuer-event versions and daily/intraday cohorts from leaking across development/evaluation splits.

next_gate: Accept source rights and time-known candidate/catalyst data; freeze cohorts, labels, intervals, latency/cost assumptions and numeric research/risk criteria before scoring and any later paper progression.

user_direction.focus: Incentive-driven highest movers; preposition or enter at an early stage.
user_direction.interpretation: Catalyst/event-driven hypotheses; no profit, timing or tradability guarantee.
user_direction.extreme_move_interest: Historical US-equity moves of +200% or more.
user_direction.factor_and_regime_workflow: Research factors/incentives and complementary data APIs; evaluate automatic strategy selection according to market status.

tracks.role: Daily candidate formation and scheduled-event pre-positioning research
tracks.signal_cutoff: Declared decision time after all required observations are actually available; a close-derived signal cannot execute at that same close.
tracks.earliest_execution: Next eligible tradable opportunity strictly after information availability and declared decision latency.
tracks.calendar: Venue-appropriate exchange calendar; XNYS baseline only where applicable.
tracks.mechanics_reference: Fixed SPY schedule is a separate accounting control, not the target strategy or a survivorship-safe universe.

tracks.role: Early catalyst/relative-volume/price-move detection and post-signal entry research
tracks.signal_cutoff: Rolling event-time cutoff with received/available timestamps and late-update policy; no final day high, final volume or revised bar available later.
tracks.earliest_execution: After signal availability plus declared observation/decision/order latency, at an eligible quote or later bar; no retroactive fill on the triggering bar.
tracks.session_scope: Regular-session first mechanical acceptance. Premarket/after-hours are separate experiments needing entitled data and a supported order/session contract; current offline guard rejects extended_hours.

distinct_measures: Prior regular close to intraday high
First executable post-signal quote to declared exit

regime_selector.decision_boundaries: Declared completed observations or source events after feature availability; daily context remains frozen between scheduled updates.
regime_selector.stale_data_behavior: Block new risk immediately; keep ownership and management of existing positions and working orders.
regime_selector.evaluation: Nested chronological evaluation of the entire selector plus strategy pool, with switching costs and fixed-strategy/no-switch controls. No retrospective regime label may guide earlier decisions.
